title: CommandWheel
description: Customize command hotkeys for one-click execution
body:
CommandWheel is a practical Minecraft command management mod with the following features:

• Press j to open GUI interface for easy command management
• Customize command hotkeys for one-click execution
• Press Alt to open radial menu with up to 8 common commands
• Smart command suggestions for efficient input
• Permission system for server admins to control access
• Multi-language support including Chinese interface

/commandwheel permission grant <player name> - Grants usage permission to the player  
/commandwheel permission revoke <player name> - Revokes the player's usage permission  
/commandwheel permission check <player name> - Checks if the player has permission  
/commandwheel permission enable <true/false> - Enables or disables permission checks  
/commandwheel permission status - Views the current permission check status
